description: Defines the MediaBufferBase class and related classes for media buffer management in Android's stagefright media framework, including buffer creation, reference counting, metadata handling, and buffer wrapping.

classes.name: MediaBufferObserver
classes.description: Interface for observing media buffer events, such as buffer return signaling.

classes.name: MediaBufferBase
classes.description: Abstract base class representing a media buffer with methods for reference management, data access, range setting, metadata, and buffer wrapping.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new MediaBufferBase instance of specified size.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Decrements reference count and potentially deletes the buffer.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the buffer data.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the size of the buffer.

methods.name: set_range
methods.description: Sets the data range within the buffer.

methods.name: meta_data
methods.description: Returns the metadata associated with the buffer.

methods.name: setObserver
methods.description: Sets an observer for buffer events.
